headline: ALMT Legal, Khaitan & Co, Latham & Watkins act on acquisition of Exdion Health by Experity
sum: Exdion Healthcare Solutions, Inc. has been acquired by Experity, Inc., a US based on-demand healthcare technology company.
detail: Exdion Healthcare Solutions, Inc. has been acquired by Experity, Inc., a US based on-demand healthcare technology company. ALMT Legal, Bangalore advised Exdion Health on the transaction. The transaction team consisted of Rajat Bopaiah (Senior Partner), Sandhya Susanna Bhaskar (Partner), Rishabh Sureka (Senior Associate) and Danika Joplin (Associate).
